entry.name: BombastFieldCannonFlavor
entry.value: The Bombast V2, separatists new cannon, is a compact weapon used exclusively in field artillery batteries. The Xenarite modification has increased its firing range and added the ability to receive target coordinates from marker drones. Its main advantage remains the same—the projectile’s arcing trajectory, which allows for indirect fire.

entry.name: SiegeEarthshakerCannonFlavor
entry.value: A reinforced, stationary version of the legendary Sotrjasatel gun. Freed from the limitations imposed by the Vasilisk chassis, the separatists were able to create an artillery system free of all previous compromises. A reinforced barrel, a fully automated ammunition feed system, and a massive foundation ensure high rate of fire and stable volleys. No matter where the target is—the enemy will hear this thunder a moment before their world is reduced to ruins.
